messages:
Rae: Quick sync — planning a short PLG credit sprint around next Wed's developer workshop. Aim: bump first-run completions + gather prompt feedback.
Owen: Good. Two credit sizes? Canary?
Rae: Canary 60 users. Test arms: 350 tokens vs 1100 tokens. Total target ~2.5k.
Tara: Routing rule idea: if lead.industry == 'platform' or intent_score > 0.65 -> SDR; otherwise enroll in onboarding + webinar drip. Webhook must send variant and credit_code.
Samir: I'll instrument events: credit_awarded(amount, variant), prompt_pack_installed(pack_id), first_run_completed. Dash: 24h activation by variant and post-1wk token usage.
Owen: Messaging tests: Variant A: 'curated prompt templates'; Variant B: 'instant free credits'. Tag promo as dev_sprint_v3_A/B.
NotifyBot: Reminder: update landing page meta and add data-promo=dev_sprint_v3 (deploy 48h out).
Rae: Owners — Owen social + landing copy, Tara routing/webhook, Samir metrics. Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for final review.
Owen: I'll drop sample social copy and schedule times by EOD. Samir: can you add baseline SQL?
Samir: Sure: `SELECT variant, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, SUM(first_run_completed::int) AS completions FROM events WHERE credit_awarded AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 14 GROUP BY variant;`
Rae: Perfect — :thumbsup:
